title: Need help finding a sprite edit (RMXP)

posts.author: AveyondFan
posts.body:
I'm somewhat at my wit's end trying to find this sprite that I know I've seen around the internet
It was the sprite of a waitress. She had the outfit of Cleric06 and, if my memory has not failed me, the hair of Mage08. There was also an edit of her carrying a plate of drinks.
If someone could point me towards source of the sprite that'd be extremely helpful. Thank you.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Sounds like it might be Pandamaru's! Looks like her site has gone offline, but her work is still on the Wayback Machine.
If memory is willing to serve, Pandamaru did one still frame of the waitress--
she's part of one of the market stalls on the tilesets page
. Wecoc did a full version of the sprite based on Pandamaru's, but I can't find the link to the thread anymore. However, you can probably recreate the sprite yourself based on Pandamaru's single frame!

Argh! That's probably who it was (Wecoc)! I remember that some of their sprites were in a pack of addons (Pack de Addons RTP 3.0 to be precise).
I wonder what happened to the thread. I had it saved in my browser and apparently it... vanished?
I tried wayback, but the resources aren't visible, so I'm sadly going to have to recreate the waitress.
Thank you for helping me solve this mystery!
Edit: The waitress was not among the sprites in the pack, sadly, so I must have seen her on the thread before it vanished.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body: Alas! But fortunately she shouldn't be too hard to recreate, since you already identified which RTP pieces were used to make her. And as a bonus, you'll have the pieces-parts already set up to make variations if you need additional waitstaff!
